messages:
Maria Chen: Quick kickoff for the launch post + webinar. Need a compact SEO preflight: redirects for promo links, canonical decision for /guestlist vs /register, JSON-LD for Event, 3 meta desc variants for A/B. 10–15 min check?

Kevin Patel: I can own redirects. Preference: 302 for short campaign links, 301 only if permanent. Will sketch nginx-safe rules and rollback notes.

Samir Rao: On schema Ill add Event + FAQ JSON-LD and OG/Twitter tags. Will include a unit test to assert presence in HTML.

Elaine Park: Pulling keywords from the benchmark narrative. Target clusters: "production inference webinar", "inference latency best practices", "reduce inference costs". Ill write 3 meta descs and drop in the doc for A/B.

Gaurav Singh: Internal linking plan: add persistent CTA in Docs and Product pages to /guestlist with utm params; show a 72-hour site banner. Tracking: GA4 event for guestlist_submitted and funnel guestlist->register.

Kevin Patel: Draft redirect snippet (first pass):
```
/webinar/social -> /guestlist?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar 302
/guestlist/submit -> /register?utm_source=guestlist-form&utm_campaign=webinar 302
/webinar/2026 -> /register?utm_source=archive&utm_campaign=webinar 301
```
Rollback: remove campaign params or restore original landing target.

Samir Rao: Minimal JSON-LD example I'll use in PR: `{ "@context":"https://schema.org", "@type":"Event", "name":"Redwood Inference Webinar", "startDate":"2026-06-10T17:00:00Z", "location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.com/register"}, "offers":{"@type":"Offer","price":"0","priceCurrency":"USD"} }`

Maria Chen: Action items: Kevin redirects PR by Mon EOD; Samir schema + tests; Elaine meta copy + KW sets; Gaurav banner + tracking. Ill coordinate UTM matrix with demand. Reconvene Tue 9am to verify staging crawl.

seo-bot: staging crawl scheduled for 2026-04-02T03:00Z. Results will post to #marketing-crawl-results.

Kevin Patel: Starting PR now. Ping if you want early review.

Elaine Park: Dropping meta variants shortly. Ping growth for quick vote.

Maria Chen: Thanks team! :thumbsup:
